title: Xun Er Goes Home
summary: Xiao Yan cultivates unconscious for three days while Xun Er and Zi Yan watch over him, and Xun Er politely receives Lin Xiu Ya, who brings medicine and clearly has a crush on her. Xiao Yan wakes as a Five-Star Dou Ling, though the Searing Poison he took in while curing Nalan Jie is still in his body, and finds that Lin Yan has joined the Rock Gate. On a walk, Ling Quan, the new deputy commander of the Black Submerged Army, arrives to take Xun Er home on her clan leader's orders and asks Xiao Yan where the Xiao Clan keeps its key. Xun Er tells Xiao Yan to hide the jade of Tuo She Gu Di and not to come for her until he is strong enough, and he swears he will become a Dou Zun, Dou Sheng or even Dou Di to bring her back. After she leaves, Ling Quan stays to tell Xiao Yan he doesn't deserve her and threatens him, until Su Qian arrives and orders him out of the Inner Academy. Yao Lao cheers Xiao Yan up and reminds him that tomorrow he enters the Blazing Qi Refining Tower for the Heart Flame's body forging.
